headline: Pressure on global chokepoints drives Asia's increased use of Arctic Trade Routes
context: Asian nations began pilot voyages over a decade ago to find routes to Europe and the Middle East that were faster and less vulnerable to chokepoints. The ongoing war has added impetus to those efforts.
